reason: I don't try anywhere new until I've read the Google reviews, and a brand-new café tucked inside another shop has none yet. $8.50 for a dessert-flavored matcha I can't vouch for is a gamble I won't take on my way to the 1 train when Matchaful is right there.
objection: It's new with no track record, and it's a café squeezed inside Mamali with barely any seats. I can't tell from a chalkboard whether it's any good or whether it'll even last.
would_change_my_mind: A solid Google rating (4.5+ with a decent number of reviews) after a few weeks, or a free tasting sip on my way past that's actually good.
